artifacts.summary: Phases 1-5 complete (measurement harness, verify-deploy.sh gate selection, invocation collapse, parallelism-safety audit, opt-in run-all.sh parallelism). Phase 6 partial (real flake found+fixed; 3-run gate validation interrupted by system memory pressure). Phase 7 not started.
Exact resume command for Phase 6's remaining 3-run flakiness-gate validation, plus the memory-pressure caveat and the baseline/load-sensitive sets to compare against.

blockers.description: System-wide memory pressure from unrelated concurrent processes (other agent sessions, pytest, lean4lean builds) on this shared development machine caused the harness's own idle-session memory-pressure safeguard to terminate a backgrounded full-suite validation run mid-execution. Confirmed via free -h/ps aux showing sustained heavy swap usage (17-19 GiB of 31 GiB) both before and after the interruption -- not transient, not caused by this task's own work.
blockers.resolution: Wait for the concurrent load to clear (check free -h before retrying), then run the 3x full-suite --jobs 4 validation from the Phase 6 handoff artifact, preferring a foreground/blocking call with a generous timeout over a backgrounded one.

next_steps: Resume at Phase 6: run the full suite 3 times at --jobs 4 with the current committed code, diff against the recorded baseline pass/fail set, inspect the 5-suite load-sensitive set, and apply the gate criterion (flip run-all.sh's default to --jobs auto, or keep --jobs 1 and close Phase 6 [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]). Then complete Phase 7 (coverage-equality proof, documentation, redeploy).
